newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas falls over three percent on results.
newsitem.headline: Havas falls over three percent on results.

text.p: Shares in Havas fell by over three percent after the company published a small rise in first half profits on Thursday evening.
At 0115 GMT, Havas was down 12.30 francs at 345.50, a decline of 3.4 percent.
"There is a decline in operating income and a rise in exceptionals that is going to undermine the 1997 results," said an analyst, adding that "the first half results are not good quality."
He added that finance director Nicolas Duhamel was "not very convincing" during a briefing this morning.
Havas on Thursday said net income after goodwill amortisation was 413 million francs for the first six months of 1996 against a pro-forma 406 million last year.
It said its operating income declined 5.1 percent to 443 million francs.
